extraction.Name: Jule F. Cuny
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (reservation not explicitly named)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment, but that he got several written notices that it was here for him, and he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged it, together with his wife's 320 acre allotment, October 17,1921, to the Rural Credit & Loan Company, Pierre, South Dakota, for $6,000.00, to pay taxes and purchase cattle; then lost the cattle as well as the allotment in 1926
extraction.Buyer: Rural Credit & Loan Company, Pierre, South Dakota, for $6,000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: mortgaged to pay taxes and purchase cattle; then lost the cattle as well as the allotment in 1926
extraction.Occupation/Income: just what he can obtain by farming and doing some road work
extraction.NOTES: Has a wife and six minor children, all of whom are enjoying fairly good health; has one grown child who is self-supporting; finds it pretty hard to support his wife and six minor children; mentally competent; health is not good — this past summer he had the influenza and blood poison; has never received any help from the County or Government; allotment was 640 acres; wife also had a 320 acre allotment; document number No. 2759; subscribed and sworn November 1928
